controles.affirmation: Hook : 'le DOJ a obtenu de la societe une provision de 526 M$ pour un dossier toujours ouvert'
controles.verbatim_source: The Company also received inquiries from the SEC and Department of Justice ('DOJ') shortly after the publication of a short seller report in March 2023. ... The DOJ inquiry remains ongoing, and in March 2026, the DOJ presented the Company with potential terms for resolving this matter. The Company disputes the basis and methodology underlying the DOJ's assessment ... The Company has accrued an estimate of loss in the amount of $526 million as of the second quarter of 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Le DOJ n'a rien 'obtenu' : c'est la societe qui a comptabilise de sa propre initiative une estimation de perte de 526 M$, tout en contestant la base et la methodologie du DOJ. Le document parle en outre d'une 'inquiry' du DOJ (demandes d'information), pas d'une enquete formelle ouverte contre la societe ; seule la procedure SEC est qualifiee d''investigation', et elle a ete close en mars 2026 sans recommandation de sanction. Reformuler : 'Block a provisionne 526 M$ face aux conditions de resolution presentees par le DOJ en mars 2026, conditions qu'elle conteste'.

controles.affirmation: Provision de 526 M$ comptabilisee au T2 2026 ; dossier ouvert depuis 2023 apres un rapport de vendeur a decouvert ; conditions de resolution presentees en mars 2026 et contestees ; negociations en cours ; issue superieure au montant provisionne raisonnablement possible
controles.verbatim_source: it is reasonably possible that the ultimate resolution could result in losses in excess of the amount accrued and such losses could be material

controles.affirmation: Recours collectif actionnaires depose en janvier 2025 sur les programmes AML/conformite 2020-2024 ; la motion to dismiss de Block rejetee le 6 janvier 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On January 17, 2025, a putative federal securities class action was filed ... between February 26, 2020 and August 1, 2024 ... On January 6, 2026, the court denied the Company's motion to dismiss.

controles.affirmation: Pertes sur transactions, prets et creances client de 585,5 M$ au T2 2026 contre 294,1 M$ (+99%) ; 0,78% du GPV contre 0,44%
controles.verbatim_source: Transaction, loan, and consumer receivable losses | 585,450 | 294,090 | ... 291,360 | 99 % ; Gross Payment Volume (GPV) (in millions) $74,734 $66,615

controles.affirmation: 'Les encours de prets n'ont progresse que de 11% sur la meme periode, ce qui n'explique qu'une fraction de la hausse des pertes'
controles.verbatim_source: The increase in loan losses was driven by significant growth in loan origination volumes of Cash App Borrow and the continued scaling of Afterpay Post-Purchase, as well as growth in Square Loans. Underlying loan loss rates and portfolio credit performance remained stable. Additionally, beginning in the second quarter of 2025, Cash App Borrow and certain other loan products were retained on our balance sheet and classified as held for investment, for which we recognize expected credit losses upfront at origination.
controles.correction_proposee: Deux problemes. (1) Le +11% est calcule sur six mois (3 383 M$ au 31 dec 2025 vs 3 749 M$ au 30 juin 2026) alors que la hausse des pertes est en glissement annuel : ce n'est pas 'la meme periode'. (2) Le 10-Q donne explicitement la cause et la contredit : taux de perte sous-jacents stables, hausse due aux volumes d'origination et au provisionnement upfront a l'origination depuis le T2 2025. Reformuler en mentionnant l'explication de la societe, ou retirer la comparaison encours/pertes.

controles.affirmation: BPA dilue GAAP 0,15 $ vs 0,87 $ et BPA ajuste 1,02 $ vs 0,62 $ ; remesure bitcoin -88,5 M$ vs +212,2 M$ ; marge brute 47,8% vs 41,9% ; marge brute bitcoin 72,4 M$ = 2% du total pour 29% du CA ; tresorerie 6,43 Md$
controles.verbatim_source: Diluted $0.15 $0.87 ; Diluted (adjusted) $1.02 $0.62 ; Remeasurement loss (gain) on bitcoin investment 88,474 (212,165) ; Bitcoin ecosystem revenue 1,893,748 / costs 1,821,343 ; Cash and cash equivalents $6,427,331
controles.correction_proposee: Detail : la preuve de l'ATT cite 'Net loss (gain) on bitcoin investment' ; l'intitule exact du 10-Q est 'Remeasurement loss (gain) on bitcoin investment'. Chiffres exacts.

controles.affirmation: 'les detenteurs de categorie B, dont Jack Dorsey identifie comme actionnaire de controle, detenaient environ 53% du pouvoir de vote au 30 juin 2026'
controles.verbatim_source: Stockholders who hold shares of Class B common stock, including certain of our executive officers, employees, and directors and their affiliates, held approximately 53% of the voting power of our combined outstanding capital stock as of June 30, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Les 53% sont exacts, mais le 10-Q cite ne designe nulle part Jack Dorsey comme actionnaire de controle : il ne nomme que 'certains de nos dirigeants, salaries et administrateurs et leurs affilies' (le seul Jack Dorsey du document est la signature du depot). Retirer la mention de Dorsey ou la sourcer sur la proxy DEF 14A.
